$description: Ant Design reference tier. antd.seed.* is antd 6.6.4 theme.defaultSeed; antd.palette.* / antd.paletteDark.* are the @ant-design/colors 8.0.1 palettes used by theme.defaultAlgorithm / theme.darkAlgorithm.

seed.$description: antd 6.6.4 theme.defaultSeed (seed tokens). Booleans, lineType and empty seeds (colorBgBase, colorTextBase, colorLink: the algorithms fill these in) are omitted.

primary.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed) for seed colorPrimary #1677ff; the palette theme.defaultAlgorithm derives colorPrimary* tokens from.

success.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed) for seed colorSuccess #52c41a; the palette theme.defaultAlgorithm derives colorSuccess* tokens from.

warning.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed) for seed colorWarning #faad14; the palette theme.defaultAlgorithm derives colorWarning* tokens from.

error.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed) for seed colorError #ff4d4f; the palette theme.defaultAlgorithm derives colorError* tokens from.

info.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed) for seed colorInfo #1677ff; the palette theme.defaultAlgorithm derives colorInfo* tokens from.

primary.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed, { theme: 'dark' }) for seed colorPrimary #1677ff; the palette theme.darkAlgorithm derives colorPrimary* tokens from.

success.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed, { theme: 'dark' }) for seed colorSuccess #52c41a; the palette theme.darkAlgorithm derives colorSuccess* tokens from.

warning.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed, { theme: 'dark' }) for seed colorWarning #faad14; the palette theme.darkAlgorithm derives colorWarning* tokens from.

error.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed, { theme: 'dark' }) for seed colorError #ff4d4f; the palette theme.darkAlgorithm derives colorError* tokens from.

info.$description: @ant-design/colors generate(seed, { theme: 'dark' }) for seed colorInfo #1677ff; the palette theme.darkAlgorithm derives colorInfo* tokens from.
